summary: Par Pacific Holdings filed an 8-K on September 28, 2026, disclosing that Richard Creamer, EVP Refining and Logistics, plans to retire on or about April 1, 2027, serving as Senior Advisor from September 28, 2026 through retirement. The board concurrently appointed Jerry Stumbo, 55, formerly VP and General Manager of Valero's Port Arthur refinery, as EVP Refining and Logistics. No price, stake, premium, advisor, or financing terms were stated; the transition was announced via press release furnished as Exhibit 99.1. The change is orderly and planned, not abrupt; watch for operational continuity at the refining segment and any subsequent compensation or separation disclosures.
